response.overview: Congratulations! You've just joined a growing family of proud Mercury Mountaineer owners. Your new compact sport utility vehicle has been designed, built and tested to provide you with years of uncompromising driving pleasure and enjoyment.  Please take a moment to view this Owner's Guide Video with everyone who will be using your new Mercury Mountaineer. This video program is designed to help you get the most out of your driving experience by familiarizing  you with Mountaineer's principal operating controls.  All of us at Lincoln-Mercuty have taken special care in this program to cover the essential features on your new Mountaineer. Nevertheless, if there is any item we haven't covered, please consult your owner's guide. It contains valuable information every owner and driver should know.  Introduction - 1:37 Safety & Security - 8:00 Comfort & Convenience - 8:16 Vehicle Maintenance - 2:46 Vehicle Operation - 2:38 Mountaineer Driving Tips - 4:23 Total Viewing Time - 28:05
response.title: 1997 Mercury Mountaineer Owner's Guide Videotape
